description: Lecturer frontend for exam sessions (Vite/React). Adds a new 'Ky thi (moi)' page to create a session (title, subject, topic, language, Nhom-3 config fields), paste a student-code list, choose examiners, and Open/Close with status display and roster validation errors; and reworks Sessions.jsx so the lecturer session LIST reads the real /exam-sessions API instead of the legacy /api/lecturer mock. EvaluationReview.jsx stays on /api/lecturer until Step 8 (left functioning behind the FEAT-001 requireAuth guard). Depends on FEAT-002 (the /exam-sessions endpoints). Grounded in: materialApi.js + Materials.jsx (page+service pattern), authApi.apiRequest, config/api.js, App.jsx routing, Sidebar.jsx nav, Sessions.jsx (current legacy fetch).
steps: Add d:\Workspace\swd392_team7_product\.worktrees\e2e-step5-exams\frontend\src\services\examSessionApi.js mirroring materialApi.js (import apiRequest from './authApi'): listExamSessions(), getExamSession(id), createExamSession(body), updateExamSession(id,patch), setExamStudents(id, codesText) (PUT /exam-sessions/:id/students; surface the 422 {ok:false,errors} via the thrown error.details), setExamExaminers(id, lecturerIds), openExamSession(id), closeExamSession(id). Reuse existing /topics (listTopics) and the admin subjects endpoint for pickers as needed.

Add d:\Workspace\swd392_team7_product\.worktrees\e2e-step5-exams\frontend\src\pages\lecturer\ExamSessions.jsx: a create form (title; subject select; topic select; language VI/EN; config inputs main_question_count/max_follow_ups_per_question/answer_time_limit_sec/think_time_sec prefilled with 3/2/120/0), a textarea to paste student codes, an examiner picker, and Open/Close buttons with a status badge. Render per-row roster errors from the 422 response. Use existing UI components (Card/CardHeader/CardBody, Button, Table, Input, Feedback) and follow Materials.jsx structure. Keep user-facing copy consistent with the current English UI strings.

Register the page: add a route <Route path="exam-sessions" element={<LecturerExamSessions />} /> under the /lecturer ProtectedRoute in frontend/src/App.jsx (and the import), and add a nav link in frontend/src/components/Sidebar.jsx.

Rework frontend/src/pages/lecturer/Sessions.jsx: replace fetch('/api/lecturer/sessions') with listExamSessions() from the new service so the list reads the real /exam-sessions API; adapt the table columns to the exam_session shape (title, subject/topic, language, status, config) and keep the search box. Do NOT change EvaluationReview.jsx's /api/lecturer data path (Step 8).

--- Files added ---
frontend/src/services/examSessionApi.js: mirrors materialApi.js, imports apiRequest from ./authApi. Exports listExamSessions/getExamSession/createExamSession/updateExamSession/setExamStudents(id,codesText -> PUT /:id/students body {codes})/setExamExaminers(id,lecturerIds)/openExamSession/closeExamSession, plus listTopics (shared /topics, filtered client-side by subject_id). The 422 roster {ok:false,errors} is surfaced via the thrown error's .details/.status (apiRequest sets error.status + error.details = full body), not a special return.
frontend/src/pages/lecturer/ExamSessions.jsx ('New Exam Session'): create form (title; subject select derived from topics' subject_id like Materials.jsx; topic select; language EN/VI; four config inputs prefilled 3/2/120/0 with min/max matching backend ranges), a sessions table with status Badge, and a per-session Manage panel: paste student codes textarea + Save roster (renders 422 per-row errors in a Code/Error table from err.details.errors), examiner lecturer-id textarea + Save examiners, and Open/Close buttons gated by status (Open enabled only on DRAFT, Close only on OPEN). Uses Card/CardHeader/CardBody, Button, Input/Textarea, Badge, Table, Feedback. English copy throughout.

--- Files changed ---
frontend/src/App.jsx: imported LecturerExamSessions and added <Route path="exam-sessions" .../> under the /lecturer ProtectedRoute (reachable at /lecturer/exam-sessions).
frontend/src/components/Sidebar.jsx: added a LECTURER nav link 'New Exam Session' (CalendarPlus icon) to /lecturer/exam-sessions.
frontend/src/pages/lecturer/Sessions.jsx: reworked to call listExamSessions() instead of fetch('/api/lecturer/sessions'); table columns adapted to the exam_session shape (Title, Subject/Topic, Language, Config as mqc/mfu/atl/ttl, Status badge); search box kept (now filters title/subject/topic/language/status).

--- Notes / decisions ---
- Examiner picker: there is no lecturer-visible endpoint listing other lecturers (admin's /admin/users and /admin/subjects are ADMIN-only), so the examiner picker is a paste-ids textarea (numeric lecturer ids) matching the backend's setExaminers({lecturerIds}) contract; the backend rejects non-LECTURER ids with VALIDATION_ERROR which the UI reports. Subject options are derived from /topics' subject_id exactly like Materials.jsx does, since no per-lecturer subjects route exists.
- EvaluationReview.jsx was NOT touched; its /api/lecturer path stays as-is (Step 8).
- The in-worktree edits use absolute worktree paths; no backend files touched (FEAT-002 already shipped the /exam-sessions API).
